execution.rationale: Freeze IDs at E3.M1; reuse Training/QuizModal; content floors; GO/NO-GO per milestone; SAMPLE labels; start at E1.M1.S1

app.name: Stock Trainer (ANALYSIS_CORE)
app.one_liner: Beginner-first equities path: market basics → financial snapshot → candles/indicators → decide-and-reveal cases → then broader markets and deeper case library.

decisions.execution_approach: contracts-first: Instrument/SamplePack → ProgressStore+frozen IDs → QuizModal literacy → E4.M0 Training soft-gate → CaseStudy player → floors 3+3 → path/unlock → live Dashboard → freeze
decisions.curriculum_principle: Equities-first, concrete before abstract: vocabulary + risk/horizon → company numbers → chart soft-gate → decide-and-see-outcome cases; options/futures/crypto after core stock fluency
decisions.mvp_scope: Beginner Equities Path wired end-to-end: literacy + statement basics + chart soft-gate + case engine with earnings + thin company news + progress unlock + dashboard; freeze before case volume / goal picker / multi-asset UI
decisions.case_study_priority: Ship E5 engine early; first content packs are equity earnings/financials and thin company news; macro/combined/scale after MVP freeze
decisions.case_study_mechanics: Context (news and/or statements + pre-reaction chart) → buy/sell/hold (short soft-gated) → reveal → grade + process debrief
decisions.financials_coverage: E4.M2 lite ratios + key lines before deep statements; E5 applies via earnings/statement cases
decisions.chart_gate: E4.M0 soft-gate wires existing candle/indicator Training onto Beginner path before graded cases
execution_rules: Freeze Beginner Equities milestone IDs at E3.M1 before E4 content writeback
One milestone in_progress at a time; GO/NO-GO before next
Reuse QuizModal/Training; do not rewrite chart stack in P0
Anti-hindsight: hide postOhlc until decision submitted
SAMPLE/STYLIZED labels; strip LIVE/REAL_TIME theater on path surfaces
Deny post-P0 until MVP freeze checklist green

beginner_learning_order: What a stock/market is (equities vocabulary) + risk/horizon
Read a simple company financial snapshot
Candles + basic indicator lines (path soft-gate before cases)
Decision cases: earnings & company news (buy/sell/hold → reveal; short soft-gated)
Then: futures/options/crypto literacy and multi-asset drills (post-MVP)

milestones.rationale: P0: packs + path IDs → vocab/risk → statements → chart soft-gate → case engine → earnings then thin company news → fixed path template → unlock + dashboard; freeze for credential. Post-P0: macro, combined, scale library, Decision Maker, richer TA, multi-asset UI for skill depth.

next_action: Implement E1.M1.S1 (Instrument + SamplePack types in src/lib) when user says go
